summary: Direct Floquet analysis of the forced periodic orbit of the cylinder in transverse oscillation at Re = 100: one converged multiplier, mu = 0.92988 (real, inside the unit circle), so the lock-in is stable.
description: Mode 3.11 on the moving mesh, about the orbit of ../210_baseflow_newton over one period of the forcing, 1 / 0.1643 = 6.086427 (read from the time stamp of the orbit file, which is checked). Krylov-Schur with k_dim = 100 and a single Arnoldi pass converges one multiplier, mu = 0.9298793 with residual 2e-10, sigma = ln(mu) / T = -0.011945. The converged value is not the first of the list sorted by modulus: the Ritz value above it, 0.996 or less, has a residual of 5e-2 and differs from run to run (0.9957, 0.9965 and 0.937 on 40, 8 and 40 ranks). The check reads Spectre_Hd_conv.dat and Spectre_NSd_conv.dat, which hold the converged values only. An export that wrote the first values of the list put 0.9957 there and fails the check; a solver without the mesh-velocity term of the perturbation equation has no converged multiplier above modulus 0.72 (first converged value -0.172 +- 0.695i) and fails it too. dns_ratio is the mean factor per period of the near-field change of the forced DNS of ../010_dns_forced over its last five periods, 0.9253, 0.5 % below |mu_1|: the DNS relaxes onto the orbit with the leading multiplier. The values are regression values of this repository, from the run named under produced.

leading_multiplier.note: Real part of the converged multiplier (observed 0.9298793 on 8 and on 40 ranks).

leading_sigma.note: sigma = ln|mu| / T of the converged multiplier, in units of U/D.

n_converged.note: Number of converged multipliers in Spectre_Hd.dat.

dns_relaxation.note: Mean factor per period of the change of the forced DNS over its last five periods (stage 010); |mu_1| = 0.92988.

orbit_period.note: Time stamp of the orbit file, the length of the map: the period of the forcing, 1 / 0.1643.
